Iron ore in sustained downtrend; BHP under existential pressure as commodity 'crumbles'
Property sector faces GFC-level stress; RBA signals no rescue, mortgage costs driving second-job participation
Gold sector active across ASX: Forrestania hits 2Moz, Aureka acquires Victorian mine for $8.9M, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory
Hormuz Strait escalation and Trump policy threats elevate geopolitical risk premium
Qantas $35M redundancy payout and jet incident weigh on QAN.AX sentiment
Santos gas cartel exposure creates energy sector volatility; SGP.AX under scrutiny
Living standards collapse masked by public sector boom; consumer spending under pressure

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; gold miners (FOR.AX, KGR.AX, AUK.AX, LRV.AX) showing relative strength on safe-haven demand
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; gold and uranium (INF.AX) offer counter-cyclical upside amid geopolitical risk

sectors.trend: Big four banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) under pressure from rising oil-driven inflation fears and property credit stress; QAN.AX hit by $35M payout and operational issues
sectors.implications: NIM compression risk if RBA holds rates; property loan book deterioration a tail risk; Qantas equity story weak

sectors.trend: Santos (SGP.AX) exposed as gas cartel scrutiny intensifies; Hormuz Strait escalation supports oil prices, benefiting Woodside (WDS.AX) and oil majors
sectors.implications: Energy names rally intraday but regulatory overhang on gas pricing caps upside; oil upside limited by demand concerns

sectors.trend: GFC-level stress in property industry; builders collapsing despite housing shortage; RBA explicitly rules out intervention; NZ house price crash a warning signal
sectors.implications: AVH.AX, CGP.AX, and construction names (WBC.AX exposure) face downside; REITs pressured by elevated rates and occupancy concerns

sectors.trend: Healthcare access barriers (waitlists, bulk billing) create policy risk for CSL.AX, SGH.AX; consumer spending squeezed by mortgage costs and second-job fatigue
sectors.implications: CSL.AX resilient long-term but near-term policy headwinds; WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from weak consumer demand

sectors.trend: ASX tech lags; Stokes family retakes Seven (SVA.AX) control; global AI/security names (Okta +20%, NVDA $20B Groq deal) drive US tech but limited ASX spillover
sectors.implications: SVA.AX governance shift may unlock value; ASX tech remains small-cap and illiquid

key_themes: Iron ore structural decline vs gold/uranium safe-haven rotation
Property sector GFC analogue with no RBA rescue
Geopolitical risk premium (Hormuz, Trump, Germany far-right)
Living standards erosion masked by public sector employment
Consumer squeeze: mortgage costs, insurance premiums, second jobs

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold (FOR.AX, KGR.AX) and uranium (INF.AX)
Underweight property REITs and construction; monitor bank NPL data; hold cash or short-duration bonds
Maintain 10-15% gold allocation; energy hedges via WDS.AX; avoid over-concentration in export-dependent miners
Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) over discretionary; monitor retail sales and second-job participation data
Monitor SGP.AX for regulatory headlines; diversify energy exposure to WDS.AX, AWE.AX

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and uranium miners as safe-haven rotation
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weakness, geopolitical risk, and gold price strength support FOR.AX, KGR.AX, AUK.AX, INF.AX, LRV.AX

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure via Woodside on Hormuz risk
opportunities.rationale: Oil price support from Strait escalation; WDS.AX less exposed to gas cartel overhang than SGP.AX

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate CSL.AX on healthcare policy tailwinds
opportunities.rationale: Healthcare access barriers drive government spending; CSL.AX benefits structurally despite near-term noise

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; trim BHP.AX and FMG.AX
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP facing existential pressure; no near-term catalyst for reversal

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property REITs and construction; hold cash
defensive_moves.rationale: GFC-level property stress with RBA explicitly ruling out intervention; NZ crash a leading indicator

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain defensive bank weighting; avoid QAN.AX
defensive_moves.rationale: Banks face NIM pressure and property credit risk; Qantas hit by $35M payout and operational incidents

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1-3 months. Iron ore weakness and property stress cap upside; energy and gold provide partial support. RBA on hold, no rescue. Volatility elevated on geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Structural iron ore decline, property correction, and living standards erosion weigh on earnings. Gold, uranium, and defensive healthcare offer relative outperformance. Recovery contingent on RBA easing and commodity stabilisation.
